mentions.name: TriviaScroll
mentions.description: A quizzing app for testing yourself after watching Jeopardy, built over a weekend. It currently includes the last three games of the past season, with plans to add more games each day until the new season starts in September.
mentions.audience: People who want to test themselves with trivia after watching Jeopardy episodes
mentions.source_excerpt:
This weekend I (& AI) made a little quizzing app for testing myself after watching Jeopardy.

Only put the last three games of this past season so far, but I will probably add more each day (re-runs are still on until the new season starts in September).
